For the reader working through Part IV. After each lesson’s Run it, tick the row if the check passed as written, and note anything that was unclear or did not behave as the text says. A sentence is enough.

Reader: ______________________   Version of the page: ________   Date started: ____________

#LessonThe checkPassedTimeWhere I stalled
1Lay out the machine (ch. 16)46 parts placed at the book’s positions; the pipe, the incline and the gates visible in Side and 3D☐
2Name the I/O: alias tags (ch. 17)Monitor Tags: Start goes to 1 when pressed; Stop is already 1; toggling Bottle_Feed_Emit drops a bottle and LS1 goes to 1☐
3Step 1: the run circuit (ch. 18)Press Start on the panel: Line_Run comes on and the Run lamp lights; Press Stop: Line_Run drops☐
4Step 2: the dwell timer and the feeder (ch. 19)Start the line: Dwell.DN comes on after a second; A bottle drops at the head of the line☐
5Step 3: index one pitch (ch. 20)The belt steps one pitch (Conv_Index); Bottles walk down the line: three dropped, one at every stop☐
6Step 4: the shift registers (ch. 21)Exist[0] bit 0 is set: LS1 saw the bottle at the head of the line; The bit walks with the bottle: Exist[0] bit 3 is set☐
7Step 5: filling (ch. 22)A bottle is filled at the filler☐
8Step 6: the reservoir and the stack light (ch. 23)The reservoir inlet opens at the low float☐
9Step 7: capping and the cap feeder (ch. 24)Start the line: the green column lamp on the capper lights; A bottle is capped☐
10Step 8: the gates, the boxes and the shredder (ch. 25)The scrap gate fires on a broken bottle; The divert gate fires on a small bottle; A small bottle reaches the packer's lower lane (Lower_Count); The shredder runs with a box under the chute☐
11Step 9: displays, preset and Enter (ch. 26)The LARGE display counts a large bottle; The SMALL display counts a small bottle☐
12Step 10: the labeler, FLS logic (ch. 27)A bottle leaves the labeler with a label☐
13Step 11: alarms and machine faults (ch. 28)Inject an overload on Main_Conv: bit 0 latches, the fault lamp flashes, the line stops; Inject a jam on Main_Conv: the end-of-line check (LS11) latches bit 2; Clear Machine Faults, press Reset, press Start: the alarms clear and the line runs again☐
14Step 12: the case packer and the VFD (ch. 29)A case stops under the packer head (Case_In_Place); The drive runs at the creep speed (Case_Speed_Ref 2500 = 15 Hz); A case is packed (Case_Full); A case of small bottles is packed from the lower lane (Case_Small_Count); A case of large bottles is packed from the deck (Case_Large_Count); STOP on Pack_HMI stops the packer and START runs it again (Pack_Run); A packed case leaves at Case_Out☐
15Step 14: hazard tape on the scrap boxes (ch. 27)A box leaves the dispenser with its hazard band (Haz_Labeler has cycled); A taped box takes glass at the grinder with none logged untaped☐
16Step 15: inspect every bottle (ch. 27)A bottle is inspected (Insp_Count moves); A passed bottle goes on past the scrap gate (a whole bottle stands there with Reject bit 0 clear and Scrap_Gate stays down); A bottle the camera failed is scrapped (Insp_Reject_Count moves and Scrap_Gate turns for Reject bit 0). Inject a fault to see one: Tools → Inject Machine Fault → labeler web break☐
17Step 13: the mix kitchen (ch. 30)The kitchen makes a batch: Mix_Step goes through 3 (heat and mix) to 4 (ready); A ready batch transfers to Supply_Tank while its inlet is open (Mix_PumpOut); The carbonator holds its CO2: Carb_Press between 19 and 22 psi with soda going through; START on Tank_HMI after a STOP runs the kitchen again (Mix_Run)☐
18Commissioning (ch. 30)Chapter 31’s checklist, every line☐
